candidate40ItemModel.reason: The small bin gain did not justify regressions on existing item classes.

broadItemBinCandidate.reason: Recognition of broad new groups improved, but the candidate did not beat the accepted ensemble or preserve the core test result.

notes: The 40-class item candidate is not deployed.
The broad-item bin candidate is retained only in the ignored training run, not deployed.
Hair tie and phone case need substantially more independent real objects before release.
Bin accuracy is stronger than exact-item accuracy and should not be presented as exact-item accuracy.
